'''2018 European MPC Results Jimmy Faelens DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jimmy Faelens]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jimmy Faelens]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Invasion Faelens DS 2018 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
